children.name: Donax carinatus Hanley, 1843
children.description: Donax carinatus is a species of small saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusc species in the family Donacidae.

children.name: Donax fossor Say, 1822
children.description: Donax fossor is a species of small saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusc species in the family Donacidae.

children.name: Donax hanleyanus R.A.Philippi, 1847
children.description: Donax hanleyanus, common name the wedge clam (in Argentina and Uruguay known as: berberecho; in Brazil (at least in Rio de Janeiro state) known as: sarnambi), is a marine bivalve mollusk species in the family Donacidae, the bean clams or wedge shells.

children.name: Donax trunculus Linnaeus, 1758
children.description: The truncate donax, abrupt wedge shell, wedge clam or coquina clam (Donax trunculus), is a bivalve species in the family Donacidae.

children.name: Donax variabilis Say, 1822
children.description: Donax variabilis, known by the common name coquina, is a species of small edible saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Donacidae, the bean clams.

children.name: Donax vittatus
children.description: Donax vittatus, or the banded wedge shell, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the order Cardiida.
